posts.author: Solarae
posts.body:
Hello everyone ♡
I'm Lizz (SolaraeStudio) and I'm a solo developer slowly working on my dream game called Dark Hearted using RPG Maker MV.
I've always loved dark, emotional stories. This project is my attempt to pour all of that into something playable. Right now it's mostly a lot of trial-and-error with events and plugins... but every tiny step forward makes me really happy.
I'm here because I want to learn from all of you, maybe share some progress (when I'm brave enough lol) and just be part of this wonderful community.
If anyone has tips for a beginner solo dev (especially with story pacing or making battles), I'd be so grateful to hear them.
Nice to meet you all, and thank you for being here.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Welcome to the forums!
Yeah, trial and Error is part of the game when making...a game lol. Hope it's not too much of a hassle for you.
You can always ask questions here, and people tend to help out quite a lot. I know I've had my fair share of questions asked and answered here
